title: Yakitori-Style Lamb Kebabs
description: A fusion twist on traditional syrian kebabs, using Japanese-style yakitori flavors. Perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together sesame oil, yuzu juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, and richly spiced.
Add lamb shoulder to marinade and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread lamb onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush skewers with remaining marinade and season with salt and pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until lamb reaches an internal temperature of 63°C.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with green onions and toasted sesame seeds.
